a.lede: Gears of War: E-Day is the first game to implement Unreal Engine's MegaLights technology, allowing for hundreds of dynamic ray-traced light sources in a scene. We put it to the test on 43 graphics cards to see what this next-gen feature demands across three generations of GPUs from Nvidia, AMD, and Intel.
a.title: Gears of War: E-Day PC graphics performance tested

b.lede: Graphics chips could draw but not compute, until the Xbox arrived.
b.title: How did retro consoles handle graphics before modern GPUs?
